label: Lessons, finished lessons and the percent
code:
COUNT(DISTINCT l.lesson_id)  AS total_lessons,
COUNT(DISTINCT lp.lesson_id) AS completed_lessons,
COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.lesson_id) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.lesson_id), 0) AS percent

label: The rows each course card is counted from
code:
FROM enrollments AS e
JOIN courses AS c
  ON c.course_id = e.course_id
LEFT JOIN lessons AS l
  ON l.course_id = c.course_id
LEFT JOIN lesson_progress AS lp
  ON lp.lesson_id = l.lesson_id
 AND lp.user_id = e.user_id
 AND lp.completed_at IS NOT NULL

label: One row per course of this learner
code:
WHERE e.user_id = :user_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.title

label: Lessons, finished lessons and the percent
code:
COUNT(DISTINCT l.lesson_id)  AS total_lessons,
COUNT(DISTINCT lp.lesson_id) AS completed_lessons,
COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.lesson_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.lesson_id)) AS INTEGER), 0) AS percent

label: Lessons, finished lessons and the percent
code:
COUNT(l.lesson_id)  AS total_lessons,
COUNT(lp.lesson_id) AS completed_lessons,
COALESCE(COUNT(lp.lesson_id) * 100 / COUNT(l.lesson_id), 0) AS percent

label: The rows each course card is counted from
code:
FROM enrollments AS e
JOIN courses AS c
  ON c.course_id = e.course_id
LEFT JOIN lessons AS l
  ON l.course_id = c.course_id
LEFT JOIN lesson_progress AS lp
  ON lp.lesson_id = l.lesson_id
 AND lp.user_id = e.user_id
